description.content:
Performs search of workorders by specified filter expression and returns list of work orders with all details.
One page contains 50 items by default ("pageSize"=50). To get next 50 items use the "page" parameter (for example page=2 and so on).

Status of work order, exact search by default

***Note***: You can get analytics from any work order. However, the analytics are mostly relevant for the work orders in the **Completed** status, as these flags rest on the Check-In/Out information.
